items.exampleEn: The kids breathed deeply before they jumped into the pool.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們跳進泳池前深深吸了一口氣。

items.exampleEn: The bus was fairly empty this morning.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上公車上蠻空的。

items.exampleEn: Many kids depend heavily on their phones.
items.exampleZh: 很多孩子非常依賴手機。
我們的旅行進行得很完美。

items.exampleEn: Can you weigh these apples for me?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我秤一下這些蘋果嗎？

items.exampleEn: The trip takes roughly two hours.
items.exampleZh: 這趟路程大約兩個小時。

items.exampleEn: The road is partly closed today.

items.sentenceZh: 雨下了一整晚，下得很大。

items.audioEn: I'd like a double room for two nights, please.
items.audioZh: 我想訂一間雙人房，住兩晚。

items.sentenceZh: 明天會有一部分時間出太陽。

items.sentenceEn: He thought deeply about the question.
items.sentenceZh: 他深入思考了這個問題。

items.stemEn: She speaks Japanese ____. Nobody knows she is from Taiwan.
items.stemZh: 她日文說得非常完美，沒人知道她是台灣人。

items.passageEn: Last summer, we flew to Japan. At the airport, our suitcase weighed roughly twenty-five kilograms. The hotel gave us a double room. It was fairly small, but it had a view of the sea. On the first day, it rained heavily, and the other days were only partly sunny. But the food was perfectly cooked, and the people were very kind to us. I will deeply miss that trip.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們搭飛機去日本。在機場，我們的行李箱大約重二十五公斤。飯店給了我們一間雙人房，房間有點小，不過看得到海。第一天下了大雨，其他幾天也只有部分時間放晴。不過食物煮得完美極了，當地人對我們也很親切。我會深深懷念那趟旅行。

questions.questionZh: 他們的行李箱大約多重？

items.promptZh: 這個房間裡大約有二十個人。
referenceEn: There are roughly twenty people in this room.
Roughly twenty people are in this room.
rubricZh: 「大約」用 roughly（寫 about 意思相同，也可以）
可寫例如 There are roughly…

items.promptZh: 她深深地愛著她的家鄉。
rubricZh: 用 deeply 表示「深深地」，可放在動詞前或句尾（例如 deeply loves、loves…deeply 等）
主詞是單數，動詞加 s（例如 loves）
「家鄉」可寫，例如 hometown、home town 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：the people were fairly kind to us 的 fairly 帶「還算、尚可」的保留語氣，放在全篇正面回憶中語氣不合；中譯「相當親切」也把語氣譯強了。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last summer, we flew to Japan. At the airport, our suitcase weighed roughly twenty-five kilograms. The hotel gave us a double room. It was fairly small, but it had a view of the sea. On the first day, it rained heavily, and the other days were only partly sunny. But the food was perfectly cooked, and the people were very kind to us. I will deeply miss that trip."（原 "Last summer, we flew to Japan. At the airport, our suitcase weighed roughly twenty-five kilograms. The hotel gave us a double room with a view of the sea. On the first day, it rained heavily, and the other days were only partly sunny. But the food was perfectly cooked, and the people were fairly kind to us. I will deeply miss that trip."）；fairly 改用在「房間有點小」這個帶保留語氣的地方
